question: What consequence follows from abstaining from food by day in this practice?
premises: Non-eating by day is specified as the means
The result concerns death related to age
The verb indicates a future outcome
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death from age.
uncertainties: The intended meaning of vayo-mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate is ambiguous; it may mean reaching death by old age rather than premature death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death by old age.
